title: Google Maps: Verify Domain
text:
## Google Maps: Verify Domain
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000071183
According to Google guidelines:
Login here to get these keys: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12078036459/original/LnG1qm_t5xwILWO4ZidEaZAT2PFfkfJwPA.png?1591114488 | alt: ]
For additional support regarding these verification keys and setting this up in your console contact Google Support: Maps API Google Support

## We recommend using the Meta Tag option -
To add the Meta Tag go to:
Settings » Design Settings » Custom CSS/HEAD » Add it inside the Additional Head Code
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105619829/original/VLjOCQlPcvM_bKn9CNp4lFLaEAtCiBacng.png?1645925393 | alt: ]
